items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Charlie Allen was on trumpet too. He was just a kid then

ctx.x: Dick Curry. Dick Curry was on drums. And, well, let me see this. And we had two, Charlie Allen was on trumpet too. He was just a kid then, but he was reaching those high notes then too. And we had two trumpets, two trombones, three saxophones, seven, four, rhythm was eleven, twelve.
Do you remember both? Do you remember both? No, what was it, Jim Hall, I think. Jim Hall. Jim Hall.
